Role

on a six-person learning team,

Key Stakeholders

VP, Global Head of Learning

Global Manager of Learning

& Development at VML

The Problem

A Fear of

Being Replaced

A Behavior Problem, Not a Features Problem

Employees didn't fear the tool. They feared what it meant for their jobs. Slide

decks and screen recordings couldn't fix that. People had to use the platform

themselves, enough times that it stopped feeling foreign.

The Twist

Security rules blocked practice inside the real platform. So we built a

simulation so accurate that users couldn't tell it apart from the real thing.

to build out a prototype in FIgma but teamwork makes the dream

work. I packaged the dialogue boxes, triggers and navigation into

Go Back

Generic AI imagery looks like the threat people were worried about. I built a friendly icon system and carried it through every touchpoint.

The palette (A cool, electric blue and yellow on dark backdrops) made the platform feel approachable, not corporate or threatening.
